newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends steady to higher.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled steady to higher, with support coming from concern about forecasts for poor growing conditions in North Dakota, traders said.
"People are just really worried that we're going to have some excessive rains over the weekend," a MGE trader said, explaining why the September and December contracts rallied.

Traders said they had also seen fund-related buying by ADM's Benson-Quinn commodity division. Traders said BQ picked up at least 1.5 million Sept bushels early and was also a featured buyer at the close.
MGE spring wheat settled steady to four cents per bushel higher, with Sept up 3-1/2 cents at $3.70-1/2.
The MGE estimated Thursday's volume at 18.492 million bushels, up from 16.23 million Wednesday.
